scope: Exploratory sky-position correlations of existing radial MOND speed residuals; no force operator or spin-axis claim.
axis_convention: Planck 2013 XXIII Table 18, SMICA kinematic-quadrupole-corrected quadrupole and octopole, Galactic l,b degrees; axes unoriented. Signed projections are separately labeled hemispheric diagnostics.
selection: Unique canonical-name match directly to PROBES table; finite J2000 RA/DEC, positive distance and finite ext_r. No residual-based exclusions. Report all missing rows.
nuisance: Eight prior features plus log10 PROBES distance and catalog ext_r; standardize training only for prediction. OLS residualization uses intercept and these ten columns for descriptive association.
sky_tests: Ten columns: signed dot and P2(dot) for quadrupole, octopole and normalized bisector; sin Galactic latitude, abs sin Galactic latitude, P2(sin J2000 barycentric mean ecliptic latitude), sin J2000 declination. P2(x)=(3x²-1)/2. No sky scan, no optimized axis.
strict_axis_control: For each of six CMB columns also condition on Galactic signed/absolute latitude, ecliptic P2 and declination. Report identifiability and residualized variance; no claim of separating nearly aligned directions.
permutation_contract: Permute nuisance-residualized target at fixed sky positions, residualize again, use maximum absolute partial correlation across ten declared columns. Descriptive reference only: spatial dependence, heteroskedasticity and model misspecification violate exchangeability.
spatial_validation: Additional leave-one-Galactic-octant-out predictions with penalties selected on remaining octants. Octants are signs of Galactic Cartesian x,y,z. Not physical group or independent-survey certification.
limitations: Historically exposed development galaxies; not confirmation.
Coordinate availability selects a subset and sky coverage is not uniform.
No uniquely measured 3D disk normal or rotation handedness; sky direction is not spin direction.
CMB anomaly axes are empirical map statistics, not established force directions.
Current scalar target is median log10 Vobs/ValgebraicMOND, not measured 3D gravitational force.
